name: hwpx-lens
description: Offline-first HWPX comparison and review desktop app

scripts.build:general: cross-env HWPX_LENS_PROFILE_CONFIG= npm run build:workspaces && node scripts/check-product-profile.mjs general public
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env HWPX_LENS_PROFILE_CONFIG= E2E_EXPECTED_PROFILE_ID=general E2E_EXPECTED_PROFILE_NAME="일반 문서" E2E_EXPECT_TABLE_FILTER= playwright test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:boundaries && npm test && npm run build && npm run audit:offline && npm run audit:ignored && npm run audit:public
scripts.tauri:build:general: cross-env HWPX_LENS_PROFILE_CONFIG= npm run tauri:build --workspace @hwpx-lens/desktop && node scripts/check-product-profile.mjs general public
